stem:
Aarav finds mushrooms on a fallen tree trunk in a garden. Soft threads spread through the rotting wood, and leaf litter under the plants shrinks over weeks.

Which claim best explains what is happening to the dead matter and waste?

options.text: Microorganisms such as fungi and bacteria grow on the dead matter and act on the waste.
Only green plants act on dead matter; fungi and bacteria do not.
The mushrooms are dead matter themselves, so they cannot act on the fallen trunk.
Dead matter disappears on its own without any living organisms acting on it.

teacher.key_rationale: Fungi (including mushrooms) and bacteria grow on dead matter and break down waste in nature.
